# IES Abroad

> IES Abroad is a leading study abroad provider offering international education programs across Europe, Latin America, Asia, and Australia for college students.

The site features extensive student blogs documenting personal experiences in destinations like Spain, France, Australia, Ecuador, and beyond. Students share cultural insights, travel adventures, language immersion experiences, and reflections on personal growth during their study abroad journeys.

## Key Topics

- Study Abroad Programs
- Cultural Immersion
- Student Experiences
- Host Family Homestays
- Language Learning
- International Travel
- Personal Growth
- Cultural Adjustment
- Spain Programs (Madrid, Granada, Barcelona)
- Australia Study Abroad
- Ecuador Programs (Quito)
- France Programs (Nantes)
- Independent Travel
- Student Blogging
- Cross-Cultural Learning

## Spain Study Abroad Experiences

- [Sol Searching](https://www.iesabroad.org/blogs/ann-kirkpatrick/sol-searching): Ann Kirkpatrick's daily life reflections from Granada, Spain program
- [A Weekend in Barcelona](https://www.iesabroad.org/blogs/ann-kirkpatrick/weekend-barcelona): Ann Kirkpatrick's Barcelona weekend trip from Granada study abroad program
- [Integration and My Spanish Home](https://www.iesabroad.org/blogs/integration-and-my-spanish-home): Student blog on homestay cultural integration experience in Madrid, Spain
- [Sleep on the plane ride home](https://www.iesabroad.org/blogs/sleep-plane-ride-home): Student reflection on Madrid study abroad experience and returning home
- [Andalucia, Olé! Visiting Sevilla and Granada](https://www.iesabroad.org/blogs/andalucia-ole-visiting-sevilla-and-granada): Student travel blog covering Andalucia's Sevilla and Granada highlights
- [Blog Post #1](https://www.iesabroad.org/blogs/vasiljon-cobo/blog-post-1): Vasiljon Cobo's first blog post from Salamanca study abroad program

## Australia Study Abroad Experiences

- [Chicken Salt](https://www.iesabroad.org/blogs/inci-askin/chicken-salt): Inci Askin's blog on Australian culture shock and food differences in Sydney
- [Around Tassie in 8 Days](https://www.iesabroad.org/blogs/bailey-gilmore/around-tassie-8-days): Bailey Gilmore's Tasmania camping trip and wildlife experience blog
- [La Vie Pastorale](https://www.iesabroad.org/blogs/bailey-gilmore/la-vie-pastorale): Bailey Gilmore's blog on pastoral countryside visit in Gippsland, Australia

## Ecuador and Latin America Programs

- [My Amazzzoning Trip](https://www.iesabroad.org/blogs/my-amazzzoning-trip): Student blog about adventure trip to Ecuador's Amazon rainforest region
- [Liga Soccer Game + Indigenous Healing Ceremony = A Good Time](https://www.iesabroad.org/blogs/liga-soccer-game-indigenous-healing-ceremony-good-time): Student blog on Quito soccer game and Ecuador cultural experiences
- [Mama Negra & Quilatoa](https://www.iesabroad.org/blogs/mama-negra-quilatoa): Ecuador travel blog covering Mama Negra festival and Quilatoa lagoon visit
- [Festivals, Protests and Large Crowds](https://www.iesabroad.org/blogs/emma-pulido/festivals-protests-and-large-crowds): Emma Pulido's blog on Buenos Aires urban life and Argentine culture
- [A Trip through Hell to Reach Heaven](https://www.iesabroad.org/blogs/trip-through-hell-reach-heaven): Student blog on challenging Inca Trail trek to Machu Picchu, Peru

## France Study Abroad Experiences

- [Mais en France](https://www.iesabroad.org/blogs/alexandra-williams/mais-en-france): Alexandra Williams on host family and cultural adjustment in Nantes, France
- [Becoming a Native](https://www.iesabroad.org/blogs/alexandra-williams/becoming-native): Alexandra Williams on French language immersion and adaptation in Nantes
- [The City of Lights- Weekend Best Friend Reunion in Paris](https://www.iesabroad.org/blogs/city-lights-weekend-best-friend-reunion-paris): Student travel blog about Paris weekend reunion and sightseeing

## European Travel and Multi-City Adventures

- [To Rome (and Madrid and Barcelona), With Love.](https://www.iesabroad.org/blogs/rome-and-madrid-and-barcelona-love): Multi-city European travel blog covering Rome, Madrid, and Barcelona
- [Finding a Natural Retreat in Vienna](https://www.iesabroad.org/blogs/colin-baumgartner/finding-natural-retreat-vienna): Colin Baumgartner's Vienna hiking and urban nature experience blog

## Program Reflections and Endings

- [The End](https://www.iesabroad.org/blogs/ariana-lisefski/end): Ariana Lisefski's semester reflection on Ireland study abroad at Limerick
